About us

A small roofing firm that does the job properly

Oakwell Roofing is run by Lewis from Morley, Leeds. Fifteen years on roofs, a small team, and a straightforward way of working.

Who we are

Oakwell Roofing Ltd is a roofing contractor based in Morley, on the south side of Leeds. It is run by Lewis, who has been roofing for 15 years, and a small team who have worked together long enough to know how each other lays a slate.

We do every kind of roofing: natural slate and stone slate on period houses, slate-effect and concrete tile on semis, GRP and single-ply flat roofs, dormers for loft conversions, chimneys, leadwork, fascias and gutters, and complete roofs on new builds for builders and developers. What we don't do is subcontract the awkward bits. The leadwork, the chimneys and the flat roofs are ours.

How we work

You call or send a photo. We come and look, properly, and tell you what the roof actually needs, which is sometimes less than you were expecting. You get a fixed price in writing with the materials named. We organise the scaffold and the skip, keep the site tidy, and when we finish you get our guarantee in writing.

We don't do pressure, we don't do "today only" prices, and we don't put logos on our van that we haven't earned. If you want to check us out, our company details are at the bottom of every page and our reviews are on Google where we can't touch them.

Where we work

All of West Yorkshire, from Morley. Leeds, Bradford, Wakefield, Huddersfield, Halifax, Dewsbury, Cleckheaton and everywhere in between. See the areas we cover.

On the ridge of a terracotta re-roof. Every job is run by Lewis in person.

How a job runs

Straightforward from first call to finished roof

  1. 1

    Call or send a photo

    Ring Lewis or message a photo on WhatsApp. If water is coming in, say so and we move it to the front of the queue.

  2. 2

    We come and look

    A proper look at the roof, on a ladder or from the scaffold, and a drone where it helps. We tell you what it actually needs.

  3. 3

    Written quote

    A fixed price in writing, with the materials named. No pressure and no obligation.

  4. 4

    The work

    Scaffold, skip and materials organised by us. We keep the site tidy and keep you informed.

  5. 5

    Guarantee in writing

    When we finish you get our workmanship guarantee in writing: 25 years on new roofs and flat roofs.

Our guarantee

Put in writing, every job

Every roof we build or repair comes with a workmanship guarantee from Oakwell Roofing Ltd. We put it in writing when the job is finished, so you know exactly what is covered and for how long.

All guarantees cover our workmanship and are provided by Oakwell Roofing Ltd. They are not insurance-backed.

Read what the guarantee covers
  • 25 years
    New roof (new slate or tile)
  • 25 years
    Flat roof (GRP or single-ply)
  • 15 years
    Re-roof using reclaimed slate or tile
  • 1 year
    Repairs
